description: This script defines a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets MAC addresses for various device models during pre-initialization based on the board name. It utilizes functions from sourced files to retrieve and modify MAC addresses and applies different configurations depending on the device type.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the device model, using board-specific logic.
